# Toyota_Caller_Identity_Agent: works out who is calling and which Toyota the call is about
# (journey 01 "Every Call": Knowing Who Is Calling; journey 05 "Book A Service": The Car).
# A shared sub-procedure. The supervisor runs it before a booking, a booking change, a status
# question or a question about the caller's own car, and runs it for a change of the phone
# number on a profile. It never greets, never explains why it asks, and completes without a
# closing line as soon as the profile and the car are settled.
#   C6   (E50, E51) registered-number caller: asks which car without listing them, then confirms the plate
#   E07  only Toyota cars are matched or mentioned; a Lexus or another brand is steered back to a Toyota,
#        a plate that belongs to another brand is not used, and a call that is only about another
#        brand goes to a person
#   E08  two profiles on one number: asks the name or a plate to tell them apart (two tries, then a person)
#   E09  landline or another number: asks the mobile the car is registered under and finds the car with it
#   E12  unknown number and no registered mobile: carries on as a guest, the name is asked only when needed
#   N05  not found by number: searched by plate, then VIN digits (SAP included), before a new profile is created
#   E13  number on file but the profile name is not the caller's: carries on on the profile, branch is notified
#   E14  calling for someone else (spouse, driver, fleet): owner's profile is kept, asks where to send the SMS
#   E10  OPEN  calling for the owner from another number: one-time code to the registered number before any
#        car detail is shared; a caller who cannot get the code goes to a person
#   E15  (E59a) company car: found by plate and registered mobile, car confirmed, driver's name and phone captured
#   K12a bought used, not yet in their name: asks if they are the new owner, uses or creates their profile,
#        says the owner change is done at the centre with the Mulkiya, ID and a fee
#   E53  bought the car, it is not in their name, and they are not the new owner (or no profile can be
#        opened for them): guest path with name, plate and phone; the kilometres are asked by the
#        booking specialist
#   E55  misheard plate: read back in short chunks; after two failed read-backs the call goes to a person
#   N15  OPEN  car on file wrong or exported: that car is not used, the record is flagged, asks which car
#   E11  OPEN  change of the profile phone number: the new number is read back in full, confirmed, and
#        checked with a one-time code before the profile is changed; only for a caller on the number
#        that is on file, anyone else goes to a person
# Three ways in (contract v2). The supervisor says why with one of two markers, and a marker is
# acted on only when it is the only one that is true. With both true, or with neither, the
# markers say nothing: the entry is then read from the session as it was before markers
# existed, a request to change the phone number is picked up by the first question that is
# asked, and no car is settled without a question.
#   only entry_profile_update is true  the phone-number change only (E11); no car is asked for
#   identity_status is not unknown     the caller is already identified: only the car is settled. The
#                                      car used earlier in the call (plate_number on entry) can be named
#                                      again without a second read-back; with exactly one Toyota on the
#                                      profile and no earlier car it is settled without a question (only
#                                      when entry_identify is the one marker that is true)
#   otherwise                          the full pass: who is calling, then which car
# Environment flags read here (unset means the interim behaviour of the use-case document):
#   TOYOTA_THIRD_PARTY_REQUIRE_CODE    "false": no code for someone calling for the owner (E10)
#   TOYOTA_CAR_RECORD_FLAG_ENABLED     "false": a wrong or exported car goes to a person, nothing is flagged (N15)
#   TOYOTA_PROFILE_CHANGE_MOBILE_MODE  "transfer": a phone-number change goes to a person (E11)
#   TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE                   "true": no profile is created and no profile number is changed for a
#                                      demonstration caller, and a caller for whom the systems return no
#                                      sample profile is not asked for a registered mobile: the outcome is
#                                      a person, which the handover agent turns into the advisor line
#                                      (E120, E121, E123)
# What goes back to the supervisor. During a pass the flow works on its own copies (id_state,
# profile_id, profile_name, message_mobile) and on what the tools stage (found_*, new_customer_id).
# The identity (identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, contact_mobile) is written in
# one step, finish. Until then identity_status is unknown, also for a caller who came in
# identified, so a caller who leaves part-way, asks for a person or raises a safety problem is
# never taken for one whose car is settled: the supervisor sends the next request that needs
# a car through this agent again. Whether a car was settled now travels in car_settled (false
# from the start of every visit, true only in finish; it stays false after a phone-number
# change, a hand-back, and a person or safety outcome). The unknown status of an unfinished
# pass is kept all the same, because the supervisor's two-pass guard and its gate for a
# booking change or a status question read identity_status alone: with a known status and no
# car settled, a booking request would match no routing rule after two passes. The price is
# that a caller who was already identified and leaves a later pass part-way is identified
# again. The car (vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model,
# vehicle_spec_region, vehicle_ownership_type, vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim,
# vehicle_record_status) is written once the caller has confirmed the plate and the record
# has been read. vehicle_id is returned only for a car on the profile in use; a car that is
# not in the caller's name travels by plate, with record status not_in_callers_name (K12a,
# E53); a car that is not on the vehicle system travels by plate with status not_found.
# caller_name and safety_note are stored as the caller says them.
# This agent never hands off, because its return re-runs the supervisor's routing. Every exit
# sets identity_outcome and completes: ok (settled, or carried on as a guest), person (with
# handover_reason and handover_summary) or safety (with safety_note). Before person or safety
# it says nothing that promises a transfer; the next agent speaks.
AGENT: Toyota_Caller_Identity_Agent
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Works out who is calling, which customer profile the call belongs to and which Toyota it is about; also changes the mobile number on a profile after a one-time code check"

GOAL: |
  Settle, with as few questions as possible, who is calling, which customer profile the call
  belongs to and which Toyota it is about, so that the next specialist never has to ask again.
  When the caller's number already identifies one profile, ask nothing about identity: only
  which car, then confirm its plate. When the caller is already identified, settle only the
  car. When the caller wants to change the mobile number on their profile, read the new
  number back and check it with a one-time code first. Finish as soon as the profile and the
  car are settled, and say nothing when finishing.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE, at the moment it needs to
  know who is calling and which car they mean. Discreet, brief and warm. You ask one short
  question at a time and never explain what happens in the background.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "Only store what each step asks for. The steps after you look up profiles and cars, send and check codes, create profiles and change numbers. Never do those yourself."
  - "Never read out anything from a profile before the caller is confirmed: no name, no phone number, no car, no booking. Never say that a profile was found, looked up or not found."
  - "Never list or count the caller's cars. Ask which car, then the plate is confirmed."
  - "Mention Toyota cars only. This line is Toyota; other brands on the same profile are not mentioned."
  - "Never guess or complete a plate, a phone number, a chassis number or a code. Use only what the caller said."
  - "Never collect or promise an email. Never give insurance, registration or legal advice."
  - "Do not book, quote, answer service or sales questions, or change a booking. Hand such a request back with the return tool; never decline it and never try to do it."
  - "Do not greet, do not replay a welcome and do not ask whether there is anything else."
  - "Never say that you are transferring or connecting the caller, and never promise a person, a callback or the safety team. When one is needed, store what the step asks and stop: the next part of the call speaks."
  - "Never name agents, systems, tools or internal steps to the caller."

LANGUAGE: "en"

INSTRUCTIONS: |
  These rules hold in every step.
  1. One short question at a time, in the caller's language. Use what the caller already said
     in this call and never ask for it again.
  2. Safety first. If the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or
     steering problem, or says they are afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to
     drive before anything else. Safe to drive and they only want it looked at: store the
     concern in safety_note and carry on. Not safe, unsure or afraid: store safety_note and
     set safety_raised to true. If they say roadside, an accident, an injury, or a child or a
     pet locked in the car: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once.
     safety_note says what they reported and what they answered about driving the car, so
     that nobody has to ask them again.
  3. If the caller asks for a person: store handover_reason caller_asked (manager_requested
     when they ask for a manager) and a handover_summary of two sentences, then set
     person_requested to true. If the caller is upset or complaining, do the same with
     handover_reason caller_upset.
  4. If the caller asks for anything else or changes their mind, hand the message back with
     the return tool, unless the step says otherwise. Never decline it and never answer it
     yourself. One request is not handed back: a caller who wants to change the phone number
     on their profile. Set number_change_wanted to true for that.
  5. If you cannot use an answer, ask the caller to say it again, at most twice in one step.
     If it is still not clear after that, store handover_reason not_understood and a
     handover_summary of two sentences, then set person_requested to true.
  6. When you store the result of a step, say nothing more. The next step speaks. This also
     holds when you set safety_raised or person_requested: do not announce a transfer.

# max_flow_iterations is the documented platform default, stated because this flow is made of
# many small fixed steps and the count runs over the whole pass, not per caller turn: a pass
# with a second plate, a one-time code or a second profile enters 80 to 95 of them, and one
# guide quotes a default of 100.
EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0.1
  max_reasoning_iterations: 4
  max_flow_iterations: 1500
  tool_timeout: 8000

USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

# One short hold line while a tool or a slow step runs: the block every agent declares
# (contract v2). The runtime plays it; no flow step speaks a hold line before a tool call.
MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_tool_call: "One moment please."
  filler_tool_call_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

# Session fields, in four groups: what the supervisor passes in and takes back (the session
# contract), the working copies of a pass, what the tools stage, and what the speaking steps
# store. READONLY fields are written by scripted steps and tools only, never by the model.
MEMORY:
  session:
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "unknown"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_outcome
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "ok"
      READONLY: true

    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's own name as they gave it: a driver, someone calling for the owner, a caller with no profile, or a caller whose name differs from the name on the profile"
    - NAME: vehicle_id

    - NAME: plate_number

    - NAME: handover_summary

    - NAME: safety_raised

      INITIAL: false

    - NAME: hint_name

TOOLS:
  lookup_customer_by_phone(phone_number: string) -> {found: boolean, profile_count: number, customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, preferred_language: string, toyota_vehicle_count: number, future_booking_count: number, open_lead_count: number}
    description: "Look up the caller's customer profile by the phone number they are calling from. Runs silently when the call connects. Returns only Toyota vehicles and bookings because this line is Toyota. Never read the result out unless the caller needs it. When profile_count is not 1, customer_id, first_name and full_name are empty; use search_customer with the name or a plate."
    auth_profile: "toyota_crm_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      phone_number:
        description: "Caller's phone number in E.164 format, for example +971501234567"
    on_result:
      set:
        profile_found: result.found
        profile_count: result.profile_count
        crm_customer_id: result.customer_id
        customer_first_name: result.first_name
        customer_name: result.full_name
        toyota_vehicle_count: result.toyota_vehicle_count
        future_booking_count: result.future_booking_count
        open_lead_count: result.open_lead_count

  search_customer(mobile_number?: string, plate_number?: string, vin_last_digits?: string, full_name?: string) -> {total: number, single_match_customer_id: string, single_match_first_name: string, matches: {customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, name_matches: boolean, mobile_last_digits: string, source_system: string}[]}
    description: "Search for a customer profile by registered mobile, plate number or the last digits of the VIN, including older cars held only in SAP. Use when the caller's number is unknown, a landline, shared by two people, or when a profile must be found before creating a new one. A mobile number, a plate or VIN digits is always needed: a name alone is not searched. single_match_customer_id and single_match_first_name are the one profile found; they are empty unless total is 1. name_matches says whether the name given in full_name matches the profile. source_system is crm or sap."
    auth_profile: "toyota_crm_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number the car is registered under, in E.164 format"
      plate_number:
        description: "Vehicle plate as spoken by the caller, emirate code and number, for example Dubai A 12345"
      vin_last_digits:
        description: "Last six digits of the vehicle identification number"
      full_name:
        description: "Caller's name, used only to tell apart two profiles that share one number"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.mobile_number != "" || params.plate_number != "" || params.vin_last_digits != ""
        on_fail: block("A mobile number, a plate or VIN digits are needed to search for a profile.")
    on_result:
      set:
        found_customer_id: result.single_match_customer_id
        found_customer_first_name: result.single_match_first_name
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, single_match_customer_id, single_match_first_name, matches[].customer_id, matches[].first_name, matches[].name_matches, matches[].mobile_last_digits, matches[].source_system]

  create_customer_profile(full_name: string, mobile_number: string, plate_number?: string, note?: string) -> {customer_id: string, created: boolean}
    description: "Create a new customer profile after search_customer found no match by number, plate or VIN. Also used for a new owner of a used car and for a sales caller using a different number."
    auth_profile: "toyota_crm_api"
    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      full_name:
        description: "Customer's full name as given on the call"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Customer's mobile number in E.164 format"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate number of the customer's car when known"
      note:
        description: "Short free-text note for the branch, for example bought used and owner change pending"
    on_result:
      set:
        new_customer_id: result.customer_id

  get_customer_vehicles(customer_id: string) -> {total: number, vehicles: {vehicle_id: string, plate_number: string, model: string, model_year: number, spec_region: string, ownership_type: string, last_service_centre_id: string, last_service_centre_name: string}[]}
    description: "List the Toyota vehicles on a customer profile. Use to confirm which car the caller means: ask which car without listing them, then confirm the plate. Lexus and other brands are not returned. spec_region is gcc or non_gcc; ownership_type is private, company or leased."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      customer_id:
        description: "Customer profile identifier from lookup_customer_by_phone or search_customer"
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, vehicles[].vehicle_id, vehicles[].plate_number, vehicles[].model, vehicles[].model_year, vehicles[].spec_region, vehicles[].ownership_type, vehicles[].last_service_centre_id, vehicles[].last_service_centre_name]

  find_vehicle(plate_number?: string, vin_last_digits?: string, registered_mobile?: string) -> {found: boolean, match_count: number, vehicle_id: string, plate_number: string, make: string, model: string, model_year: number, spec_region: string, ownership_type: string, sold_by_al_futtaim: boolean, record_status: string, owner_customer_id: string}

Also call it with the confirmed plate before any booking, to load spec region, ownership, where the car was sold and the record status. With registered_mobile alone it returns a car only when exactly one matches; match_count says how many matched. Returns spec_region (gcc or non_gcc), ownership_type (private, company or leased), sold_by_al_futtaim, and record_status (active, wrong, exported or not_found). make is the brand in lower case, for example toyota or lexus; this line serves toyota only."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      plate_number:

CONSTRAINTS:
  always:
    # The speaking steps list verify_one_time_code as their only tool. This rule keeps it closed
    # there: it opens only for the scripted check that follows the code question (E10, E11).
    - REQUIRE otp_check_open == true BEFORE calling verify_one_time_code
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK
    # E10, E11: a code is texted only when the flow has decided so.
    - REQUIRE otp_send_allowed == true BEFORE calling send_one_time_code
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK
    # E11: the number on a profile changes only after the caller said yes to the new number read
    # back in full, the new number passed the code, and only for a caller on the number on file.
    - REQUIRE otp_verified == true AND id_state == "matched" AND newmobile_confirm == "yes" BEFORE calling update_customer_mobile
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK
    # N05, K12a: a profile is created only after the searches came back empty or for a new owner.
    - REQUIRE profile_create_allowed == true BEFORE calling create_customer_profile
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

# There is no hand-off section on purpose (contract v2): this agent returns identity_outcome
# and the supervisor's first two rules take the caller to a person or to the safety
# specialist. The error handlers do not hand off either.
ON_ERROR:
  # E26: a failed tool call has had the one retry the tool library allows (none for a tool
  # that sends or changes something). The flow step that made the call decides what happens
  # next (its ON_FAILURE branch): a person. A tool argument that fails validation is treated
  # the same way.
  tool_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: CONTINUE

  validation_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: CONTINUE

  # A failed model call or a step that timed out: one retry, then fail_system. That step makes
  # no model call and no tool call: it sets handover_reason system_error, a short summary and
  # identity_outcome person, and completes, so the caller is never left on a step that cannot
  # answer.
  llm_error:
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: BACKTRACK
    BACKTRACK_TO: fail_system

  timeout_error:
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: BACKTRACK
    BACKTRACK_TO: fail_system

  unknown_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: BACKTRACK
    BACKTRACK_TO: fail_system

  routing_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: BACKTRACK
    BACKTRACK_TO: fail_system

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Entry. Every activation starts clean and takes one of three roads (contract v2): the
  # phone-number change alone (E11), the car alone for a caller who is already identified, or
  # the full pass. What the supervisor passed is copied into the working fields first; the
  # name the caller gave earlier (caller_name) and a safety note are kept as they came.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  start:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [said_mobile, hint_name, heard_plate, said_vin, said_full_name, said_code, said_contact_mobile, new_mobile, bad_car_details, name_issue_note, match_first, match_second, profile_vehicles, only_vehicle, car_label, registered_mobile, profile_basis, otp_purpose, otp_sent_digits, otp_target_spoken, otp_reference, otp_sent, otp_verified, create_note, new_profile_mobile, bad_car_issue, flag_customer_id, fail_note, handover_reason, handover_summary]
    SET:
      identity_outcome = "ok"
      car_settled = false
      id_state = "unknown"
      exit_status = "unknown"
      profile_id = COALESCE(crm_customer_id, "")
      profile_name = COALESCE(customer_name, "")
      message_mobile = COALESCE(contact_mobile, "")
      entry_plate = COALESCE(plate_number, "")
      mobile_outcome = "pending"
      hint_outcome = "pending"
      car_outcome = "pending"
      plate_outcome = "pending"
      vin_outcome = "pending"
      name_outcome = "pending"
      ownership_outcome = "pending"
      code_outcome = "pending"
      contact_outcome = "pending"
      newmobile_outcome = "pending"
      newmobile_confirm = "pending"
      caller_relation = "self"
      name_on_file_wrong = false
      plate_tries = 0
      hint_tries = 0
      otp_tries = 0
      bad_car_count = 0
      other_brand_count = 0
      mismatch_count = 0
      newmobile_tries = 0
      n05_active = false
      car_done = false
      tp_code_done = false
      car_vin_tried = false
      entry_known = false
      entry_trusted = false
      plate_from_caller = false
      registered_asked = false
      change_task = false
      change_is_entry = false
      change_lookup_done = false
      otp_send_allowed = false
      otp_check_open = false
      profile_create_allowed = false
      safety_raised = false
      person_requested = false
      number_change_wanted = false
    CHECK: entry_profile_update == true AND entry_identify != true
    ON_FAIL: entry_identify_gate
    THEN: change_marked

  # E11 (contract v2): the supervisor passed entry_profile_update and it is the only marker
  # that is true, so this entry is the phone-number change and nothing else. The marker is
  # consumed here, so a later entry for another reason does not find it. The status the
  # supervisor holds is the one to start from, and the one that goes back if the change ends
  # with a person: a profile change says nothing about a car, so it never takes an identity
  # away.
  change_marked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      entry_profile_update = false
      change_is_entry = true
      id_state = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(identity_status, "unknown"), "unknown")
      exit_status = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(identity_status, "unknown"), "unknown")
    THEN: change_mode_gate

  # Contract v2, section 1: a marker is acted on only when it is the only one that is true.
  # Only entry_identify: the task is the gate (who is calling, and which car). The marker is
  # consumed here, and entry_trusted records that the supervisor named this task.
  entry_identify_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: entry_identify == true AND entry_profile_update != true
    ON_FAIL: entry_unmarked
    THEN: entry_identify_marked

  entry_identify_marked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      entry_identify = false
      entry_trusted = true
    THEN: entry_known_gate

  # Both markers true, or neither: they say nothing about this entry (values that reached this
  # agent without being passed for it, or an entry that carried none). Both are put back and
  # the task is worked out as it was before markers existed: from the identity the supervisor
  # holds (entry_known_gate), with a request to change the phone number picked up by the first
  # question that is asked (number_change_wanted, then change_asked). On such an entry no car
  # is settled without a question (single_car_gate), so the request is always read by a
  # speaking step before this agent finishes.
  entry_unmarked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      entry_identify = false
      entry_profile_update = false
    THEN: entry_known_gate

  # Contract v2: a caller who is already identified is not identified again. A status that
  # comes without a profile (other than guest) is not trusted and takes the full pass.
  entry_known_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: identity_status IS SET AND identity_status != "" AND identity_status != "unknown" AND (identity_status == "guest" OR profile_id != "")
    ON_FAIL: identity_begin
    THEN: known_begin

  # The status that came in is kept in id_state. identity_status itself goes back to unknown
  # for the length of the pass: if the caller leaves before the car is settled, the supervisor
  # sends the request through this agent again instead of taking the car as settled.
  known_begin:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = identity_status
      entry_known = true
    THEN: known_hold

  known_hold:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      identity_status = "unknown"
    CHECK: id_state == "guest"
    ON_FAIL: known_third_gate
    THEN: known_guest

  # E12, E53: a guest has no profile; the caller gives the plate.
  known_guest:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "guest"
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
    THEN: known_company_gate

  # E14, E10: someone calling for the owner. Whether a code was needed was settled earlier in
  # the call and is not asked again.
  known_third_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: id_state == "third_party" OR id_state == "third_party_verified"
    ON_FAIL: known_matched_gate
    THEN: known_third

  known_third:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_relation = "third_party"
      tp_code_done = true
      profile_basis = "known"
    THEN: known_company_gate

  known_matched_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: id_state == "matched"
    ON_FAIL: known_confirmed
    THEN: known_matched

  # C6: a caller on the number that is on file.
  known_matched:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "phone"
      registered_mobile = caller_phone
    THEN: known_company_gate

  known_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "known"
    THEN: known_company_gate

  # E15 with E70 (contract v2): the supervisor passes the ownership type of the car used
  # earlier in this call. When that car was a company car, the caller is a company driver: on
  # this pass too the driver gives the plate, and the cars on the company's profile are not
  # used for matching (car_zone_gate). How the caller relates to the next car is still read
  # from its own record (wrap_company_gate).
  known_company_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_ownership_type == "company" AND caller_relation == "self"
    ON_FAIL: car_stage
    THEN: known_company_set

  known_company_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_from_caller = true
    THEN: car_stage

  # The full pass: nobody has identified this caller yet. Nothing about a car is carried over,
  # and a plate from an earlier, unfinished pass is not offered to a caller who is not known.
  identity_begin:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      identity_status = "unknown"
      id_state = "unknown"
      entry_plate = ""
    CLEAR: [vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, vehicle_spec_region, vehicle_ownership_type, vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim, vehicle_record_status]
    THEN: lookup_known

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Who is calling. The profile was looked up in the background when the call connected. A
  # lookup that never came back is repeated once here, silently, because a booking needs it;
  # if that fails too the caller is treated as new and asked for the registered mobile (E09).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lookup_known:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_found IS SET
    ON_FAIL: lookup_retry_gate
    THEN: lookup_found_gate

  lookup_retry_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_phone IS SET AND caller_phone != ""
    ON_FAIL: mobile_ask_prep
    THEN: lookup_retry

  lookup_retry:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: lookup_customer_by_phone
      WITH:
        phone_number: caller_phone
      AS: phone_lookup
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: phone_lookup.found == true
        SET:
          profile_id = phone_lookup.customer_id
          profile_name = phone_lookup.full_name
        THEN: lookup_count_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: mobile_ask_prep
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: mobile_ask_prep

  lookup_found_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_found == true
    ON_FAIL: mobile_ask_prep
    THEN: lookup_count_gate

  # E08: two or more profiles on the calling number.
  lookup_count_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_count >= 2
    ON_FAIL: matched_gate
    THEN: shared_start

  matched_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: mobile_ask_prep
    THEN: matched_start

  # C6: one profile on the calling number. No question about identity and no one-time code.
  # The number for messages (contact_mobile) is a number the caller gave or confirmed in this
  # call (contract v2): none is made up here. Without one, the next specialist uses the
  # registered number and confirms its last digits.
  matched_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "matched"
      profile_basis = "phone"
      registered_mobile = caller_phone
    THEN: profile_ready

  # E08: the lookup names no profile when the number carries two; neither is used until the
  # caller's name or plate singles one out.
  shared_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "phone"
      registered_mobile = caller_phone
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
    THEN: hint_ask_prep

  hint_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      hint_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [hint_name]
    THEN: hint_ask

  # How the speaking steps (REASONING: true) work, here and below. Each asks one thing in the
  # caller's language and stores the answer; the scripted steps around it do every lookup,
  # every count and every decision. A speaking step ends when its outcome field is stored, or
  # when the caller raised a safety problem, asked for a person, or asked to change the phone
  # number on their profile (E11). Its only listed tool is kept closed by a CONSTRAINTS rule,
  # so it cannot call a business tool. MAX_ATTEMPTS bounds caller turns that end without a
  # result; the exact counts of the use cases (E55) are kept by counters in scripted steps.
  # E08: asks the name or a plate to tell the profiles apart.
  hint_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      More than one customer shares this phone number. Without saying so, ask for the
      caller's full name or the plate number of their car, in one short question.
      {{#if hint_tries}}What they gave before did not single out one customer. Ask for the other detail: the plate number if they gave a name, the full name if they gave a plate. Do not reuse the detail from before.{{/if}}
      {{#if change_task}}The caller is here to change the phone number on their profile, and this question comes first. Leave number_change_wanted as it is.{{/if}}
      If the caller already gave their name or the plate in this call, use it and do not ask.
      - A name: store it in hint_name, then set hint_outcome to "name".
      - A plate: store it in heard_plate as emirate, code and number (for example Dubai A 12345), then set hint_outcome to "plate". Do not read it back here.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups. Do not volunteer why you ask; if the caller asks, say only that it is to find the right details for them."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "If the caller says they are calling for someone else, store third_party in caller_relation; a company car, company; bought the car and it is not in their name yet, new_owner. If they give their own name, store it in caller_name. Do not ask about this."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: hint_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR (number_change_wanted == true AND change_task != true)
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: hint_route

  # This question is also asked on the way to a phone-number change (E11): the request to
  # change the number is then already being handled and does not leave the step.
  hint_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND (number_change_wanted != true OR change_task == true)
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: hint_route_plate

  hint_route_plate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: hint_outcome == "plate" AND heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate != ""
    ON_FAIL: hint_route_name
    THEN: shared_search_plate

  hint_route_name:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: hint_outcome == "name" AND hint_name IS SET AND hint_name != ""
    ON_FAIL: fail_not_understood
    THEN: shared_search_name

  # The plate given here has not been read back yet: it is confirmed before the car is used.
  # The one profile found is staged by the tool in found_customer_id (tool library v2). A name
  # the caller added is not checked by this search, so it is not kept as the name on file.
  shared_search_plate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [hint_name]
    CALL: search_customer
      WITH:
        mobile_number: registered_mobile
        plate_number: heard_plate
      AS: profile_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: profile_search.total == 1
        THEN: profile_take
      - ELSE:
        CLEAR: [heard_plate]
        THEN: hint_retry
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  # E08 by name. The search always goes by the number; the name only tells the profiles on it
  # apart. Either the search returns the one profile that carries the name, or it returns both
  # profiles, each marked with name_matches, and exactly one of them must carry it.
  shared_search_name:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_customer
      WITH:
        mobile_number: registered_mobile
        full_name: hint_name
      AS: profile_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: profile_search.total == 1
        THEN: profile_take
      - IF: profile_search.total == 2
        SET:
          match_first = profile_search.matches[0]
          match_second = profile_search.matches[1]
        THEN: shared_name_first
      - ELSE:
        THEN: hint_retry
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  shared_name_first:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: match_first.name_matches == true AND match_second.name_matches != true
    ON_FAIL: shared_name_second
    THEN: shared_take_first

  shared_name_second:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: match_second.name_matches == true AND match_first.name_matches != true
    ON_FAIL: hint_retry
    THEN: shared_take_second

  shared_take_first:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      found_customer_id = match_first.customer_id
      found_customer_first_name = match_first.first_name
    THEN: profile_take

  shared_take_second:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      found_customer_id = match_second.customer_id
      found_customer_first_name = match_second.first_name
    THEN: profile_take

  # E08: one more try with the other detail, then a person.
  hint_retry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      hint_tries = ADD(hint_tries, 1)
    CHECK: hint_tries >= 2
    ON_FAIL: hint_ask_prep
    THEN: fail_profile_unclear

  # One profile singled out by a search. The search returns no full name (tool library v2):
  # the name kept is the one the caller gave when it matched (E08), else the first name on
  # the profile.
  profile_take:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_id = found_customer_id
      profile_name = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(hint_name, found_customer_first_name), "")
      n05_active = false
    CHECK: profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: fail_profile_unclear
    THEN: profile_basis_gate

  # A profile on the calling number counts as matched, also when the caller said "the number I
  # am calling from" and the search found it; a profile found by another stated mobile, a plate
  # or VIN digits counts as confirmed.
  profile_basis_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_basis == "phone" OR (registered_mobile IS SET AND registered_mobile == caller_phone)
    ON_FAIL: profile_confirmed
    THEN: profile_matched

  profile_matched:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "matched"
    THEN: profile_ready

  # The registered mobile the caller gave is the number for messages, unless they already gave
  # another one in this call.
  profile_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "confirmed"
      message_mobile = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(message_mobile, registered_mobile, said_mobile), "")
    THEN: profile_ready

  # The profile is known. E11 (contract v2): when the task is the phone-number change, that
  # is all it needs and no car is asked for.
  profile_ready:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_task == true
    ON_FAIL: tp_check
    THEN: change_identity_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # E09: the calling number is not on file (a landline, another number, or no lookup result).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # No profile is in use on this path, so nothing remembered about one is kept.
  # E11: a caller who is not on a number on file does not change a profile here: a person.
  mobile_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      mobile_outcome = "pending"
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
    CLEAR: [said_mobile, hint_name]
    CHECK: change_task != true
    ON_FAIL: fail_change_unverified
    THEN: mobile_demo_gate

  # E120 (demonstration): an attendee is never asked for a real mobile number. The
  # demonstration runs on the sample customer the systems return for the calling number; when
  # they return none, or the car belongs to someone else, nothing is asked here: the outcome
  # is a person, the handover agent says the advisor line (E123) and the demonstration
  # carries on. The profile rule says the same to the model; this gate holds it for the flow.
  mobile_demo_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: mobile_ask
    THEN: fail_demo_no_sample

  # E09: asks for the mobile the car is registered under. E12: no registered mobile, a guest.
  mobile_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is not known from the number they are calling from. Ask one short question:
      which mobile number the car is registered under. Never say that anything was looked up
      or not found.
      {{#if (eq caller_relation "third_party")}}The caller is calling for the car's owner: ask for the mobile number the owner registered the car under.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq caller_relation "company")}}This is a company car: ask for the mobile number the company registered the car under.{{/if}}
      If the caller already gave this number in this call, use it and do not ask again.
      - A mobile number: read the whole number back in groups of three or four digits and wait for a yes. Then store it in said_mobile in international format (a UAE number such as 050 123 4567 becomes +971501234567) and set mobile_outcome to "mobile".
      {{#if caller_phone}}- The number they are calling from: set mobile_outcome to "same_number". Do not repeat the number.{{/if}}
      - No number registered with us, never a customer before, or they do not know it: set mobile_outcome to "none".
      - They bought the car and it is still under the previous owner: store new_owner in caller_relation and set mobile_outcome to "none". Do not take the previous owner's number.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups. Do not volunteer why you ask; if the caller asks, say only that it is to find the right details for them."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "If the caller says they are calling for someone else, store third_party in caller_relation; a company car, company. If they give their own name, store it in caller_name. Do not ask about this."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: mobile_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: mobile_route

  mobile_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: mobile_route_same

  # "The number I am calling from": the calling number is used without being read out. The
  # search that follows also covers older records the first lookup does not.
  mobile_route_same:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: mobile_outcome == "same_number" AND caller_phone IS SET AND caller_phone != ""
    ON_FAIL: mobile_route_given
    THEN: mobile_use_caller

  mobile_use_caller:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      said_mobile = caller_phone
    THEN: profile_search_mobile

  mobile_route_given:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: mobile_outcome == "mobile" AND said_mobile IS SET AND said_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: mobile_route_none
    THEN: profile_search_mobile

  # Only a clear "no registered mobile" goes on without a number. An answer that names a
  # number but stored none is not taken for "none": a person.
  mobile_route_none:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: mobile_outcome == "none"
    ON_FAIL: fail_not_understood
    THEN: mobile_none_gate

  # E12: a caller with no registered mobile of their own carries on as a guest.
  # E14, E15: someone calling for an owner or a company who does not know the registered
  # mobile is not a guest: the owner's profile is looked for by plate, so the booking still
  # goes on the owner's profile and the code rule for third parties (E10) still applies.
  mobile_none_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_relation == "third_party" OR caller_relation == "company"
    ON_FAIL: no_profile_guest
    THEN: mobile_none_search

  mobile_none_search:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      n05_active = true
    THEN: car_stage

  # E09: finds the profile with the registered mobile. N05 starts when it is not found.
  profile_search_mobile:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "mobile"
    CALL: search_customer
      WITH:
        mobile_number: said_mobile
      AS: profile_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: profile_search.total == 1
        SET:
          registered_mobile = said_mobile
        THEN: profile_take
      - IF: profile_search.total >= 2
        SET:
          registered_mobile = said_mobile
        THEN: hint_ask_prep
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          n05_active = true
        THEN: car_stage
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  # N05: not found by number. The confirmed plate is searched next; the search covers older
  # cars held only in SAP.
  profile_search_plate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "plate"
    CALL: search_customer
      WITH:
        plate_number: heard_plate
      AS: profile_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: profile_search.total == 1
        THEN: profile_take
      - IF: profile_search.total >= 2
        THEN: fail_profile_unclear
      - ELSE:
        THEN: vin_ask_prep
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  vin_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      vin_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [said_vin]
    THEN: vin_ask

  # N05: not found by number or plate, so the last digits of the VIN are tried.
  vin_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Ask for the last six characters of the car's chassis number, in one short question. If
      the caller asks where to find it, say it is on the car's registration card.
      - Six characters: repeat them back one by one and wait for a yes. Then store them in said_vin and set vin_outcome to "vin".
      - They do not have it to hand: set vin_outcome to "unknown".
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups. Do not volunteer why you ask; if the caller asks, say only that it is to find the right details for them."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: vin_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: vin_route

  vin_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: vin_route_given

  vin_route_given:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vin_outcome == "vin" AND said_vin IS SET AND said_vin != ""
    ON_FAIL: n05_create_gate
    THEN: profile_search_vin

  profile_search_vin:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_basis = "vin"
    CALL: search_customer
      WITH:
        vin_last_digits: said_vin
      AS: profile_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: profile_search.total == 1
        THEN: profile_take
      - ELSE:
        THEN: n05_create_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  # A new profile is opened for the caller themselves. Someone calling for an owner or a
  # company who cannot be found carries on as a guest instead (E12).
  n05_create_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_relation != "third_party" AND caller_relation != "company"
    ON_FAIL: no_profile_guest
    THEN: n05_create

  # N05: number, plate and VIN digits all came back empty. Only now is a new profile opened.
  n05_create:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_create_allowed = true
      create_note = "Profile opened on the call: nothing was found by number, plate or VIN digits."
    CLEAR: [profile_basis]
    THEN: name_ask_prep

  # E120, E121 (demonstration): no profile is created for a demonstration caller and no real
  # name is asked for one; the caller carries on as a guest. The profile rule says the same to
  # the model; this gate holds it for the scripted call as well.
  name_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      name_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [said_full_name]
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: name_ask
    THEN: no_profile_guest

  # N05, K12a: the full name for a new profile. It is written to a new record, so it is said
  # back once and confirmed before it is stored.
  name_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Ask for the caller's full name, in one short question. If they already gave it in this
      call, use it and do not ask.
      {{#if caller_name}}The caller gave this name earlier in the call: {{caller_name}}. If it is a full name, say it back and confirm it instead of asking; if it is only a first name, ask for the family name.{{/if}}
      - A name: say it back once and wait for a yes. Then store it in said_full_name and set name_outcome to "name".
      - They prefer not to give it: set name_outcome to "declined".
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups. Do not volunteer why you ask; if the caller asks, say only that it is to find the right details for them."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: name_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: name_route

  name_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: name_route_given

  # Without a name no profile is opened: the caller carries on as a guest (E12, E53).
  name_route_given:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: name_outcome == "name" AND said_full_name IS SET AND said_full_name != ""
    ON_FAIL: no_profile_guest
    THEN: create_prepare

  # A profile needs a mobile number: the one the caller gave, else the one they are calling
  # from. With neither (a withheld number) no profile is opened and the caller is a guest.
  create_prepare:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      new_profile_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(said_mobile, caller_phone)
    CHECK: new_profile_mobile IS SET AND new_profile_mobile != "" AND profile_create_allowed == true
    ON_FAIL: no_profile_guest
    THEN: profile_create

  # N05: new profile. K12a: new owner's profile, with the car details in the note. The name,
  # the number and the plate were each said back and confirmed before this call. The new
  # profile's id is staged by the tool in new_customer_id (tool library v2).
  profile_create:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: create_customer_profile
      WITH:
        full_name: said_full_name
        mobile_number: new_profile_mobile
        plate_number: heard_plate
        note: create_note
      AS: new_profile
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: new_profile.created == true AND new_profile.customer_id != ""
        SET:
          profile_create_allowed = false
        THEN: profile_created
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          profile_create_allowed = false
        THEN: no_profile_guest
    ON_FAILURE:
      SET:
        profile_create_allowed = false
      THEN: no_profile_guest

  profile_created:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_id = new_customer_id
      profile_name = said_full_name
      id_state = "confirmed"
      profile_basis = "created"
      message_mobile = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(message_mobile, said_mobile), "")
      n05_active = false
    CHECK: car_done == true
    ON_FAIL: car_find
    THEN: k12a_tell

  # E12: unknown number and no registered mobile: the caller carries on as a guest.
  # E53: the car is not in their name and they are not the new owner: the guest path. No
  # profile is used: the profile id and name go back empty (contract v2). Also where a new
  # profile could not be opened.
  no_profile_guest:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "guest"
      profile_basis = "guest"
      n05_active = false
      profile_create_allowed = false
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
    CLEAR: [profile_vehicles, registered_mobile]
    CHECK: car_done == true
    ON_FAIL: car_stage
    THEN: wrap_contact_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # E14, E10: someone calling for the owner. This check runs after the profile is known, again
  # before a plate is read back, and again before finishing, so a caller who says it late is
  # still covered and no car detail is shared first.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  tp_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_relation == "third_party" AND profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != "" AND tp_code_done != true
    ON_FAIL: resume_route
    THEN: tp_check_phone

  # A caller who holds the registered phone needs no code: that phone is where it would go.
  tp_check_phone:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_basis == "phone" OR (registered_mobile IS SET AND registered_mobile == caller_phone)
    ON_FAIL: tp_check_flag
    THEN: tp_set_verified

  tp_set_verified:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "third_party_verified"
      tp_code_done = true
    THEN: resume_route

  # OPEN E10 (Aftersales workshop): When someone calls for the owner, is a code needed before booking?
  # Interim: yes. Set TOYOTA_THIRD_PARTY_REQUIRE_CODE to "false" to book without a code (E14 only).
  tp_check_flag:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_THIRD_PARTY_REQUIRE_CODE}}" == "false")
    ON_FAIL: tp_code_setup
    THEN: tp_set_unverified

  tp_set_unverified:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "third_party"
      tp_code_done = true
    THEN: resume_route

  # E10 (tool library v2): the code is sent through the owner's profile, so the registered
  # number never enters this agent, and a profile found by plate or VIN digits can be sent a
  # code as well. The code service says which digits the number ends in.
  tp_code_setup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      otp_purpose = "third_party_caller"
      otp_tries = 0
      otp_send_allowed = true
    CLEAR: [otp_reference, otp_sent, otp_verified, otp_sent_digits, otp_target_spoken]
    THEN: otp_send

  # E10: texts a code to the registered number of the owner's profile. The code service is
  # not retried: a second send would issue a second code.
  otp_send:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_one_time_code
      WITH:
        purpose: "third_party_caller"
        customer_id: profile_id
      AS: otp_dispatch
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: otp_dispatch.sent == true
        SET:
          otp_send_allowed = false
          otp_sent_digits = otp_dispatch.sent_to_last_digits
        THEN: otp_sent_note
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          otp_send_allowed = false
        THEN: otp_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      SET:
        otp_send_allowed = false
      THEN: fail_system

  # The last three digits of the number the code went to, spaced so they are said one by one.
  otp_sent_note:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      otp_target_spoken = TRIM(REGEX_REPLACE(COALESCE(REGEX_EXTRACT(otp_sent_digits, "[0-9]{1,3}$"), ""), "([0-9])", "$1 "))
    THEN: code_ask_prep

  code_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      code_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [said_code]
    THEN: code_ask

  # E10, E11: the caller reads the code out. A caller who cannot get it goes to a person (E10).
  # E11: a caller who gives the change up, or asks for something else while the code is
  # awaited, ends the change here (nothing is changed) instead of leaving it half done.
  code_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      {{#if (eq otp_purpose "third_party_caller")}}A one-time code has just been sent by text to the mobile number the owner has registered with us. Tell the caller that and ask them to get the code from the owner and read it out.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq otp_purpose "change_mobile_number")}}A one-time code has just been sent by text to the new number. Tell the caller that and ask them to read it out when it arrives.{{/if}}
      {{#if otp_target_spoken}}The number the code went to ends in {{otp_target_spoken}}. You may say those last digits and no other part of the number.{{/if}}
      {{#if otp_tries}}The code they read did not match. Say so in a few words and ask them to read it again.{{/if}}
      - They read a code: store the digits, with no spaces, in said_code, then set code_outcome to "code". Do not repeat the code back and do not check it yourself.
      - They cannot get the code, or it does not arrive: set code_outcome to "no_code".
      {{#if (eq otp_purpose "third_party_caller")}}- They ask for something else or change their mind: hand the message back with the return tool. If they want to change the phone number on their profile, set number_change_wanted to true instead.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq otp_purpose "change_mobile_number")}}- They no longer want to change the number, or they ask for something else instead: set code_outcome to "cancelled". Do not hand the message back.{{/if}}
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Never guess, complete or invent a code. Say nothing else about profiles, records or cars."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: code_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR (number_change_wanted == true AND change_task != true)
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: otp_failed
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: code_route

  code_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND (number_change_wanted != true OR change_task == true)
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: code_route_cancel

  # E11: the caller gave the change up while the code was awaited.
  code_route_cancel:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: code_outcome == "cancelled" AND otp_purpose == "change_mobile_number"
    ON_FAIL: code_route_given
    THEN: change_cancelled

  code_route_given:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      otp_check_open = true
    CHECK: code_outcome == "code" AND said_code IS SET AND said_code != "" AND otp_reference IS SET AND otp_reference != ""
    ON_FAIL: otp_failed
    THEN: otp_verify

  otp_verify:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: verify_one_time_code
      WITH:
        code_reference: otp_reference
        code: said_code
      AS: otp_check
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: otp_check.verified == true
        SET:
          otp_check_open = false
        THEN: otp_passed
      - IF: otp_check.attempts_left > 0
        SET:
          otp_check_open = false
        THEN: otp_retry
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          otp_check_open = false
        THEN: otp_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      SET:
        otp_check_open = false
      THEN: fail_system

  # A wrong code may be read again while the code service allows it (attempts_left), three
  # times at most. Every check uses up one attempt at the code service, so it is never repeated
  # by an error handler.
  otp_retry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      otp_tries = ADD(otp_tries, 1)
    CHECK: otp_tries >= 3
    ON_FAIL: code_ask_prep
    THEN: otp_failed

  otp_passed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      code_outcome = "pending"
    CHECK: otp_purpose == "change_mobile_number"
    ON_FAIL: tp_passed
    THEN: change_apply

  # E10: the code passed, so car details may be shared with this caller.
  tp_passed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "third_party_verified"
      tp_code_done = true
    THEN: resume_route

  # E10: the caller cannot get the code: a person. E11: nothing is changed, a person.
  otp_failed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      otp_check_open = false
      otp_send_allowed = false
    CHECK: otp_purpose == "change_mobile_number"
    ON_FAIL: fail_tp_code
    THEN: fail_change_code

  # Where to carry on after the third-party check: the wrap-up when the car is settled, the
  # plate read-back when a plate is waiting to be confirmed, otherwise the car question.
  resume_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: car_done == true
    ON_FAIL: resume_route_readback
    THEN: wrap_contact_gate

  resume_route_readback:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate != "" AND plate_outcome != "yes"
    ON_FAIL: car_stage
    THEN: plate_readback_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Which car.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  car_stage:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate != "" AND plate_outcome == "yes"
    ON_FAIL: car_stage_profile
    THEN: plate_confirmed

  car_stage_profile:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: plate_ask_prep
    THEN: vehicles_load

  # E07: the list holds Toyota cars only; other brands on the profile never reach this agent.
  # The list is read for the profile in use, so it is right also when that is not the profile
  # of the calling number (the count from the start-up lookup is not used for that reason).
  vehicles_load:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_customer_vehicles
      WITH:
        customer_id: profile_id
      AS: vehicle_list
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: vehicle_list.total == 1
        SET:
          profile_vehicles = vehicle_list.vehicles
          only_vehicle = vehicle_list.vehicles[0]
        THEN: single_car_gate
      - IF: vehicle_list.total >= 2
        SET:
          profile_vehicles = vehicle_list.vehicles
        THEN: car_zone_gate
      - ELSE:
        CLEAR: [profile_vehicles]
        THEN: plate_ask_prep
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  # Contract v2: the caller is already identified, the profile holds exactly one Toyota and no
  # car was used earlier in the call: that car is settled without a question. It applies only
  # to a caller who may hear car details (the profile holder, or someone who passed the code),
  # and not after a car was turned down in this pass. On the full pass C6 still asks.
  # It also applies only when the supervisor named this entry as the gate (entry_trusted):
  # when the markers said nothing, the caller is asked which car, so that a request to change
  # the phone number is heard by a speaking step and is never dropped in silence.
  single_car_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: entry_trusted == true AND entry_known == true AND entry_plate == "" AND bad_car_count == 0 AND other_brand_count == 0 AND (caller_relation == "self" OR id_state == "third_party_verified")
    ON_FAIL: car_zone_gate
    THEN: single_car_take

  single_car_take:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      heard_plate = only_vehicle.plate_number
      car_outcome = "plate"
      plate_outcome = "yes"
    CHECK: heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate != ""
    ON_FAIL: car_zone_gate
    THEN: plate_confirmed

  # The cars on file are used for matching only with a caller who may hear car details: the
  # profile holder, or a third party who holds the registered phone or passed the code (E10).
  # A company driver and an unverified third party give the plate themselves (E15, E14); so
  # does a caller whose earlier car on this call was a company car (plate_from_caller).
  car_zone_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_vehicles IS SET AND plate_from_caller != true AND caller_relation != "company" AND (caller_relation != "third_party" OR id_state == "third_party_verified")
    ON_FAIL: plate_ask_prep
    THEN: car_ask_prep

  car_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      car_outcome = "pending"
      plate_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [heard_plate]
    THEN: car_ask

  # C6: asks which car without listing them. E07: Toyota only. E13: a different name on file.
  car_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Find out which Toyota this call is about. Ask which car, in one short question. Never
      read out, list or count the caller's cars, and add no detail the caller has not said.
      Toyota cars on file, for matching only:
      {{#each profile_vehicles}}
      - {{this.model}} {{this.model_year}}, plate {{this.plate_number}}
      {{/each}}
      {{#if bad_car_count}}The car named before cannot be used on this call. Say so in one short sentence, give no reason from the record, and ask which other car the call is about. Do not pick that car again.{{/if}}
      {{#if other_brand_count}}The plate given before belongs to a car of another brand. Say this line looks after Toyota cars, and ask which Toyota the call is about.{{/if}}
      {{#if entry_plate}}A car was already confirmed earlier in this call: plate {{entry_plate}}. If the caller clearly means that same car again (also when they just say "my car" and it is the only car above), store that plate exactly in heard_plate and set car_outcome to "same_car". Never read that plate out and never assume it: ask which car when they have not said.{{/if}}
      {{#if safety_note}}Earlier on this call the caller mentioned: {{safety_note}}. That has been dealt with: do not ask about it again unless they report something new.{{/if}}
      If the caller already said which car in this call, use that and do not ask again.
      - It fits exactly one car above, or they say "my car" and there is only one: store that car's plate exactly as written above in heard_plate, then set car_outcome to "plate". Do not read the plate out here; the next step confirms it.
      - It fits more than one car above: ask for the plate number or the model year.
      - A Toyota or a plate that is not above: get the plate from the caller, store it in heard_plate as emirate, code and number (for example Dubai A 12345), then set car_outcome to "plate".
      - A Lexus or another brand: say this line looks after Toyota cars and ask whether the call is about a Toyota. If they say it is only about that other car, set car_outcome to "other_brand".
      - They cannot say which car, or do not know the plate of a car that is not above: set car_outcome to "no_plate".
      {{#if (eq profile_basis "phone")}}Name on the profile of this number, for comparison only: "{{profile_name}}". Never say that name. Skip this point if it is empty, or if the caller already said they are calling for someone else or about a company car. If the caller gives their own name and it is clearly a different person, ask once whether the car is in their own name or they are calling for someone else. Their own name: set name_on_file_wrong to true, store their name in caller_name and one sentence for the branch in name_issue_note. Someone else: store third_party in caller_relation and their name in caller_name.{{/if}}
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Never list or count the cars and never read out a plate, a year or a model the caller has not said. Mention Toyota cars only."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "If the caller says they are calling for someone else, store third_party in caller_relation; a company car, company; bought the car and it is not in their name yet, new_owner. If they give their own name, store it in caller_name. Do not ask about this."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: car_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: car_route

  plate_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      car_outcome = "pending"
      plate_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [heard_plate]
    THEN: plate_ask

  # The caller gives the plate: a guest, a company driver, an unverified third party, a profile
  # with no Toyota on file, the N05 search, and the second try after a failed read-back (E55).
  # E13: a caller on a number on file who gives a different name is asked about it here too.
  plate_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Get the plate number of the Toyota this call is about: the emirate, the letter or number
      code, then the number. Ask for it in one short question.
      {{#if plate_tries}}The last read-back was not right. Apologise in a few words and ask the caller to say the plate again slowly.{{/if}}
      {{#if bad_car_count}}The car named before cannot be used on this call. Say so in one short sentence, give no reason from the record, and ask which other car the call is about.{{/if}}
      {{#if other_brand_count}}The plate given before belongs to a car of another brand. Say this line looks after Toyota cars, and ask for the plate of the Toyota.{{/if}}
      {{#if entry_plate}}A car was already confirmed earlier in this call: plate {{entry_plate}}. If the caller clearly means that same car again, store that plate exactly in heard_plate and set car_outcome to "same_car". Never read that plate out and never assume it.{{/if}}
      If none of the notes above applies and the caller already said the plate in this call, use it and do not ask again.
      {{#if safety_note}}Earlier on this call the caller mentioned: {{safety_note}}. That has been dealt with: do not ask about it again unless they report something new.{{/if}}
      - Plate heard: store it in heard_plate as emirate, code and number (for example Dubai A 12345), then set car_outcome to "plate". Do not read it back here; the next step confirms it.
      - A Lexus or another brand: say this line looks after Toyota cars and ask whether the call is about a Toyota. If they say it is only about that other car, set car_outcome to "other_brand".
      - The caller does not know the plate: set car_outcome to "no_plate".
      {{#if (eq profile_basis "phone")}}Name on the profile of this number, for comparison only: "{{profile_name}}". Never say that name. Skip this point if it is empty, or if the caller already said they are calling for someone else or about a company car. If the caller gives their own name and it is clearly a different person, ask once whether the car is in their own name or they are calling for someone else. Their own name: set name_on_file_wrong to true, store their name in caller_name and one sentence for the branch in name_issue_note. Someone else: store third_party in caller_relation and their name in caller_name.{{/if}}
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups. Mention Toyota cars only."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "If the caller says they are calling for someone else, store third_party in caller_relation; a company car, company; bought the car and it is not in their name yet, new_owner. If they give their own name, store it in caller_name. Do not ask about this."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: car_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: car_route

  car_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: car_route_same

  # Contract v2: the car confirmed earlier in this call is meant again. It was read back and
  # confirmed then, so it is not read back a second time; its record is read afresh. The
  # stored plate must be exactly the earlier one, otherwise it is read back like any other.
  car_route_same:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: car_outcome == "same_car" AND entry_plate != "" AND heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate == entry_plate
    ON_FAIL: car_route_plate
    THEN: car_same_set

  car_same_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_outcome = "yes"
    THEN: tp_check

  # E10: the third-party check runs before the plate is read back.
  car_route_plate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: (car_outcome == "plate" OR car_outcome == "same_car") AND heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate != ""
    ON_FAIL: car_route_brand
    THEN: tp_check

  # E07: the call is only about a car of another brand. This line is Toyota: a person.
  car_route_brand:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: car_outcome == "other_brand"
    ON_FAIL: car_route_unknown
    THEN: fail_other_brand

  car_route_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: car_outcome == "no_plate"
    ON_FAIL: fail_not_understood
    THEN: fail_car_not_identified

  plate_readback_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [bad_car_details]
    THEN: plate_readback

  # C6: confirms the plate. E55: reads it back in short chunks.
  plate_readback:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Confirm the plate with the caller. Read this plate back in short chunks, the emirate,
      then the code, then the digits two or three at a time, and ask if it is right:
      {{heard_plate}}
      Say only the plate and, if the caller named it, the model. Add nothing else.
      - Yes: set plate_outcome to "yes".
