      - No, and they give the right plate: store the corrected plate in heard_plate, then set plate_outcome to "corrected".
      - No, without a correction: set plate_outcome to "no".
      - They say this car is no longer theirs, was sold or exported, or was never theirs: store one sentence about it in bad_car_details, then set plate_outcome to "wrong_car".
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Read back only what is written in this step. Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "If the caller says they are calling for someone else, store third_party in caller_relation; a company car, company; bought the car and it is not in their name yet, new_owner. If they give their own name, store it in caller_name. Do not ask about this."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: plate_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: plate_route

  plate_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: plate_route_yes

  plate_route_yes:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: plate_outcome == "yes"
    ON_FAIL: plate_route_wrong_car
    THEN: plate_confirmed

  # N15: the caller says the car on file is no longer theirs.
  plate_route_wrong_car:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: plate_outcome == "wrong_car"
    ON_FAIL: plate_count
    THEN: bad_car_said

  # E55: after two failed read-backs the call goes to a person.
  plate_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_tries = ADD(plate_tries, 1)
    CHECK: plate_tries >= 2
    ON_FAIL: plate_retry_gate
    THEN: fail_plate

  # A corrected plate is read back straight away; otherwise the caller is asked to say it again.
  plate_retry_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: plate_outcome == "corrected" AND heard_plate IS SET AND heard_plate != ""
    ON_FAIL: plate_ask_prep
    THEN: plate_readback_prep

  # The plate is confirmed, so the E55 count starts again for any later plate.
  # N05: while no profile is found, the confirmed plate is searched before the car is looked up.
  plate_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_tries = 0
    CHECK: n05_active == true AND (profile_id IS NOT SET OR profile_id == "")
    ON_FAIL: car_find
    THEN: profile_search_plate

  # Establishes the facts about the car: spec region, ownership type, where it was sold and
  # the state of its record. The booking specialist applies the eligibility rules.
  # Tool library v2: the lookup stages what it found in found_* and writes none of the contract
  # variables. They are written in car_accept_own, car_accept_other and car_plate_only: after
  # the caller confirmed the plate, and only for a record that can be used.
  # E07: a plate that belongs to a car of another brand is not used.
  # N15: a record marked wrong or exported is not used.
  # Every branch names the result it needs, so a call that failed matches none of them and
  # goes to ON_FAILURE, and from there to a person.
  car_find:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_vehicle
      WITH:
        plate_number: heard_plate
      AS: car_lookup
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: car_lookup.found == false
        THEN: car_missing
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND car_lookup.make IS SET AND car_lookup.make != "" AND car_lookup.make != "toyota"
        THEN: car_other_brand
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND car_lookup.record_status == "exported"
        THEN: bad_car_exported
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND car_lookup.record_status == "wrong"
        THEN: bad_car_wrong
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND profile_id != "" AND car_lookup.owner_customer_id == profile_id
        THEN: car_accept_own
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true
        THEN: car_accept_other
      - ELSE:
        THEN: fail_system
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  # Not on the vehicle system by this plate. When VIN digits were given (N05) they are tried once.
  car_missing:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: said_vin IS SET AND said_vin != "" AND car_vin_tried != true
    ON_FAIL: car_plate_only
    THEN: car_find_vin

  car_find_vin:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      car_vin_tried = true
    CALL: find_vehicle
      WITH:
        vin_last_digits: said_vin
      AS: car_lookup
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: car_lookup.found == false
        THEN: car_plate_only
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND car_lookup.make IS SET AND car_lookup.make != "" AND car_lookup.make != "toyota"
        THEN: car_other_brand
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND car_lookup.record_status == "exported"
        THEN: bad_car_exported
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND car_lookup.record_status == "wrong"
        THEN: bad_car_wrong
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true AND profile_id != "" AND car_lookup.owner_customer_id == profile_id
        THEN: car_accept_own
      - IF: car_lookup.found == true
        THEN: car_accept_other
      - ELSE:
        THEN: fail_system
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_system

  # E07: the plate belongs to a car of another brand. This line is Toyota: the car is not used
  # and the caller is asked for the Toyota once; a second such plate goes to a person.
  car_other_brand:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      other_brand_count = ADD(other_brand_count, 1)
    CHECK: other_brand_count >= 2
    ON_FAIL: car_stage_profile
    THEN: fail_other_brand

  # The car is not on the vehicle system. The confirmed plate still travels with the call;
  # what a record would have given goes back empty, with record status not_found.
  car_plate_only:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_number = heard_plate
      vehicle_id = ""
      vehicle_model = ""
      vehicle_spec_region = ""
      vehicle_ownership_type = ""
      vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim = false
      vehicle_record_status = "not_found"
    THEN: wrap_entry

  # The car is on the profile in use: its record is used as it is.
  car_accept_own:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      vehicle_id = found_vehicle_id
      plate_number = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(found_plate_number, heard_plate), "")
      vehicle_model = found_vehicle_model
      vehicle_spec_region = found_spec_region
      vehicle_ownership_type = found_ownership_type
      vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim = found_sold_by_al_futtaim
      vehicle_record_status = found_record_status
    THEN: wrap_entry

  # K12a, E53, E12: the car is on the vehicle system but not on a profile in use: the caller
  # has no profile, or the car is linked to another customer. As far as this call knows it is
  # not in the caller's name. The plate, the model and the facts the booking rules need go
  # back; the vehicle record id does not, and the record status says not_in_callers_name.
  # With a profile in use, the next step finds out how the caller relates to the car.
  car_accept_other:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      vehicle_id = ""
      plate_number = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(found_plate_number, heard_plate), "")
      vehicle_model = found_vehicle_model
      vehicle_spec_region = found_spec_region
      vehicle_ownership_type = found_ownership_type
      vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim = found_sold_by_al_futtaim
      vehicle_record_status = "not_in_callers_name"
    CHECK: profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: wrap_entry
    THEN: owner_mismatch

  # OPEN N15 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
  # Interim: the car is not used, the record is flagged and the caller is asked which car.
  # The flag goes on the profile in use, else on the customer the car is linked to.
  bad_car_exported:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      bad_car_issue = "exported_vehicle"
      bad_car_details = JOIN(["The vehicle record for plate", heard_plate, "is marked exported, and the caller asked for help with this car."], " ")
      flag_customer_id = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(profile_id, found_owner_customer_id), "")
    THEN: bad_car_drop

  bad_car_wrong:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      bad_car_issue = "wrong_vehicle"
      bad_car_details = JOIN(["The vehicle record for plate", heard_plate, "is marked wrong, and the caller asked for help with this car."], " ")
      flag_customer_id = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(profile_id, found_owner_customer_id), "")
    THEN: bad_car_drop

  # N15: the caller said at the read-back that the car is no longer theirs. Its record was not
  # read in this step, so the flag goes on the profile in use only.
  bad_car_said:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      bad_car_issue = "wrong_vehicle"
      bad_car_details = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(bad_car_details, "The caller says a car on their profile is no longer theirs.")
      flag_customer_id = COALESCE(profile_id, "")
    THEN: bad_car_drop

  # N15: do not book on that car: nothing about it is written to the contract variables. Set
  # TOYOTA_CAR_RECORD_FLAG_ENABLED to "false" to send these callers to a person instead of
  # flagging the record and asking which car.
  bad_car_drop:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      bad_car_count = ADD(bad_car_count, 1)
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_CAR_RECORD_FLAG_ENABLED}}" == "false")
    ON_FAIL: bad_car_flag_gate
    THEN: fail_bad_car

  bad_car_flag_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: flag_customer_id IS SET AND flag_customer_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: bad_car_next
    THEN: bad_car_flag

  # N15: flags the record, with the plate the flag is about. The flag never blocks the call
  # and is not repeated when it fails.
  bad_car_flag:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: flag_customer_record
      WITH:
        customer_id: flag_customer_id
        issue_type: bad_car_issue
        details: bad_car_details
        plate_number: heard_plate
      AS: car_flag
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: bad_car_next
    THEN: bad_car_next

  # N15: asks which car. A second car that cannot be used goes to a person.
  bad_car_next:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: bad_car_count >= 2
    ON_FAIL: car_stage_profile
    THEN: fail_bad_car

  # The car is linked to a different customer than the profile in use. A caller already known
  # to act for someone else is re-identified under the owner's registered mobile (E14, E15);
  # otherwise the ownership question decides (K12a, E53). A second mismatch goes to a person.
  owner_mismatch:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      mismatch_count = ADD(mismatch_count, 1)
      car_done = true
    CHECK: mismatch_count >= 2
    ON_FAIL: owner_mismatch_kind
    THEN: fail_car_owner

  owner_mismatch_kind:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_relation == "third_party" OR caller_relation == "company"
    ON_FAIL: ownership_ask_prep
    THEN: reidentify

  # E14, E15: the booking belongs on the owner's profile, so the owner's registered mobile is
  # asked for and the profile, the code check and the car are run again with it. The plate
  # already confirmed is kept; where messages go is asked again at the end. That also holds
  # for a caller who came in identified: from here on the pass is about another profile, so
  # nothing settled earlier in the call is taken as known (entry_known), and the question
  # where the message should go (E14) is asked.
  reidentify:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "unknown"
      car_done = false
      tp_code_done = false
      n05_active = false
      name_on_file_wrong = false
      entry_known = false
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
      message_mobile = ""
    CLEAR: [profile_vehicles, registered_mobile, profile_basis]
    THEN: mobile_ask_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The car is settled. What is left depends on how the caller relates to it.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  wrap_entry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      car_done = true
      car_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(vehicle_model, "Toyota")
    CHECK: caller_relation == "new_owner"
    ON_FAIL: wrap_company_gate
    THEN: k12a_own_gate

  # K12a applies while the car is not in the caller's name. A car that is already on the
  # caller's own profile needs no owner change and nothing is asked. A profile that was found
  # through the car itself (by plate or VIN digits) is the previous owner's, so the question
  # is still asked there.
  k12a_own_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_record_status == "active" AND profile_id != "" AND profile_basis != "plate" AND profile_basis != "vin"
    ON_FAIL: ownership_ask_prep
    THEN: wrap_company_gate

  # E15: the vehicle record says company car even when the caller did not.
  wrap_company_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_ownership_type == "company" AND caller_relation == "self"
    ON_FAIL: tp_check
    THEN: wrap_company_set

  wrap_company_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_relation = "company"
    THEN: tp_check

  ownership_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      ownership_outcome = "pending"
      car_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(vehicle_model, "Toyota")
    THEN: ownership_ask

  # K12a: asks if they are the new owner. Also asked when the car is linked to another customer.
  ownership_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      {{#if (eq caller_relation "new_owner")}}The caller said they bought this car and it is not in their name yet. Ask one question: are they the new owner of the car? If they have already said clearly that they are, do not ask again.{{/if}}
      {{#if (ne caller_relation "new_owner")}}Ask one neutral question: is this car registered in the caller's own name? Say nothing about whose name it is in and nothing else from the record.{{/if}}
      Set ownership_outcome to one of these values:
      - new_owner, when they bought the car and are its new owner and it is not in their name yet.
      - not_owner, when they bought it for someone else or the new owner is another person.
      - someone_else, when the car belongs to a spouse, relative or friend they are calling for.
      - company, when it is a company or fleet car.
      - own, when they say it is already registered in their own name.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Say nothing about profiles, records or lookups, and never say whose name the car is in."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "Give no advice on registration, insurance or the law. If they ask how the car is put in their name, say only that it is done at the service centre."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: ownership_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: ownership_route

  ownership_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: ownership_route_new

  ownership_route_new:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ownership_outcome == "new_owner"
    ON_FAIL: ownership_route_guest
    THEN: k12a_start

  ownership_route_guest:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ownership_outcome == "not_owner"
    ON_FAIL: ownership_route_other
    THEN: e53_start

  ownership_route_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ownership_outcome == "someone_else"
    ON_FAIL: ownership_route_company
    THEN: reidentify_other

  # A caller who says a car linked to another customer is in their own name goes to a person.
  ownership_route_company:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ownership_outcome == "company"
    ON_FAIL: fail_car_owner
    THEN: reidentify_company

  reidentify_other:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_relation = "third_party"
    THEN: reidentify

  reidentify_company:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_relation = "company"
    THEN: reidentify

  # K12a: the caller is the new owner and the car is not in their name yet. The car goes back
  # by plate with record status not_in_callers_name and without the vehicle record id, so the
  # booking specialist puts the car details in the booking notes.
  k12a_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_relation = "new_owner"
      vehicle_record_status = "not_in_callers_name"
      vehicle_id = ""
    THEN: k12a_profile_gate

  # K12a: the new owner's own profile is used when there is one. A profile that was found
  # through the car itself belongs to the previous owner and is not used.
  k12a_profile_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != "" AND profile_basis != "plate" AND profile_basis != "vin"
    ON_FAIL: k12a_new_profile
    THEN: k12a_tell

  # K12a: creates the new owner's profile, with the car details in the note.
  k12a_new_profile:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "unknown"
      profile_create_allowed = true
      create_note = JOIN(["Bought the car used; change of ownership still to be done at the centre. Car:", car_label, "plate", heard_plate], " ")
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
    CLEAR: [profile_vehicles, registered_mobile, profile_basis]
    THEN: name_ask_prep

  # K12a: says the owner change is done at the centre with the Mulkiya, ID and a fee.
  k12a_tell:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "The change of ownership itself is done at the service centre. Please bring the Mulkiya and your ID; a fee applies."
    MESSAGE_KEY: owner_change_at_centre
    THEN: wrap_flag_gate

  # E53: the car is not in their name and they are not the new owner: the guest path with name,
  # plate and phone. The car goes back by plate, like K12a.
  e53_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      vehicle_record_status = "not_in_callers_name"
      vehicle_id = ""
    THEN: no_profile_guest

  # E14: asks where to send the SMS. E15: the driver's name and phone. E12, E53: a guest's
  # name when the request needs it, and the number for messages.
  wrap_contact_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_relation == "third_party" OR caller_relation == "company" OR id_state == "guest"
    ON_FAIL: wrap_flag_gate
    THEN: contact_known_gate

  # Contract v2: on a later pass in the same call nothing is asked twice. The number for
  # messages was settled earlier (and, for a company car, the driver's name was given).
  contact_known_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: entry_known == true AND message_mobile != "" AND (caller_relation != "company" OR (caller_name IS SET AND caller_name != ""))
    ON_FAIL: contact_ask_prep
    THEN: wrap_flag_gate

  contact_ask_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      contact_outcome = "pending"
    CLEAR: [said_contact_mobile]
    THEN: contact_ask

  # One question at a time: for a company car the driver's name comes first, then the number.
  contact_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      {{#if (eq caller_relation "third_party")}}The caller is calling for the car's owner. Ask one question: where the confirmation text should go: the number they are calling from, the owner's registered number, or another mobile.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq profile_basis "phone")}}The caller is on the registered phone itself: offer this number or another mobile, and do not name the registered number as a separate choice.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq caller_relation "company")}}This is a company car. Ask for the driver's name first. When you have it, ask in a second question which mobile number goes on the booking: the one they are calling from or another one.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq id_state "guest")}}The caller has no profile with us. Ask for their name only if their request is a booking or a change to a booking. Ask which mobile number to use for messages only if they said they are not calling from their own mobile.{{/if}}
      {{#if caller_name}}The caller gave this name earlier in the call: {{caller_name}}. Do not ask for their name again; ask for a name only when the driver is someone else.{{/if}}
      {{#if registered_asked}}The caller chose the owner's registered number, but that number is not known on this call, so a message cannot be sent to it. Say so in a few words and ask whether it should go to the number they are calling from or to another mobile. Do not offer the registered number again.{{/if}}
      Use what the caller already said in this call and do not ask for it again. If nothing needs asking, set contact_outcome to "this_number" without saying anything.
      A different number for messages is not a change of the number on the profile: it is stored here and number_change_wanted stays as it is.
      - A name (the driver, someone calling for the owner, or a caller with no profile): store it in caller_name.
      - Messages to the number they are calling from: set contact_outcome to "this_number".
      - Messages to the owner's registered number: set contact_outcome to "registered_number".
      - Messages to another mobile: read the whole number back in groups of three or four digits and wait for a yes. Then store it in said_contact_mobile in international format (050 123 4567 becomes +971501234567) and set contact_outcome to "other_number".
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Never read out a number or a name from the record. Never ask for or promise an email."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more. Wants to change the phone number on their profile: set number_change_wanted to true and do not hand that back. Any other request or a change of mind: hand the message back with the return tool."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values or to hand the message back. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: contact_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true OR number_change_wanted == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: contact_route

  contact_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true AND number_change_wanted != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: contact_route_other

  contact_route_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: contact_outcome == "other_number" AND said_contact_mobile IS SET AND said_contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: contact_route_registered
    THEN: contact_set_other

  contact_route_registered:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: contact_outcome == "registered_number"
    ON_FAIL: contact_route_this
    THEN: contact_registered_gate

  # The calling number is used only when the caller chose it. "Another number" without a
  # number stored is not taken for it: a person.
  contact_route_this:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: contact_outcome == "this_number"
    ON_FAIL: fail_not_understood
    THEN: contact_caller_gate

  contact_set_other:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_mobile = said_contact_mobile
    THEN: contact_name_gate

  # The owner's registered number. When this call never learned it (the profile was found by
  # plate or VIN digits), no agent can send a message to it: the message tool needs a number,
  # and the next specialist would fall back to the calling number without saying so. The
  # caller is therefore told once that it cannot go to that number and asked to choose again
  # (contact_registered_retry). Only if they choose it a second time is the number for
  # messages left empty; the specialist that sends the message then states the number it uses
  # at its own read-back.
  contact_registered_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_mobile = ""
    CHECK: registered_mobile IS SET AND registered_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: contact_registered_unknown
    THEN: contact_set_registered

  contact_registered_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: registered_asked != true
    ON_FAIL: contact_name_gate
    THEN: contact_registered_retry

  contact_registered_retry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      registered_asked = true
    THEN: contact_ask_prep

  contact_set_registered:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_mobile = registered_mobile
    THEN: contact_name_gate

  # The number they are calling from. When it is withheld, the number for messages is left
  # empty and the specialist that sends a message asks for a number then.
  contact_caller_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_mobile = ""
    CHECK: caller_phone IS SET AND caller_phone != ""
    ON_FAIL: contact_name_gate
    THEN: contact_set_caller

  contact_set_caller:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_mobile = caller_phone
    THEN: contact_name_gate

  # E12, E53: with no profile there is no name on file. The caller's own name travels in
  # caller_name (contract v2), also when they gave it for a profile that was not opened.
  contact_name_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: id_state == "guest"
    ON_FAIL: wrap_flag_gate
    THEN: guest_name_set

  guest_name_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_name = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(said_full_name, caller_name), "")
    THEN: wrap_flag_gate

  # E13: the number is on file but the profile name is not the caller's. The call carries on
  # on the profile and the branch is told to fix the name. The flag never blocks the call.
  wrap_flag_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: name_on_file_wrong == true AND profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: finish_guard
    THEN: name_flag

  name_flag:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      name_issue_note = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(name_issue_note, "The caller is on a number on file and says the name on the profile is not theirs.")
    CALL: flag_customer_record
      WITH:
        customer_id: profile_id
        issue_type: "name_mismatch"
        details: name_issue_note
      AS: name_flag_result
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: finish_guard
    THEN: finish_guard

  # The supervisor routes back here while identity_status is unknown, so a finished pass never
  # returns it unknown: a caller with no profile leaves as a guest (E12).
  finish_guard:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: id_state != "unknown"
    ON_FAIL: finish_as_guest
    THEN: finish

  finish_as_guest:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "guest"
      profile_id = ""
      profile_name = ""
    THEN: finish

  # The step that writes the identity into the session contract once the car is settled
  # (contract v2); change_finish does the same after a phone-number change, without a car. For
  # a guest the profile id and the name on file go back as empty strings, so the supervisor's
  # copies from the start-up lookup are emptied. identity_outcome ok tells the supervisor that
  # nobody else is needed; nothing is said here, the next agent speaks. car_settled goes back
  # true here and on no other exit: every way into this step comes after the car was written
  # to the contract variables (car_accept_own, car_accept_other or car_plate_only).
  finish:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      identity_status = id_state
      crm_customer_id = profile_id
      customer_name = profile_name
      contact_mobile = message_mobile
      identity_outcome = "ok"
      car_settled = true
      handover_reason = ""
      handover_summary = ""
    THEN: COMPLETE

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OPEN E11 (contact centre): Who can currently change the main mobile on a profile: contact
  # centre agents, or only the service centre?
  # Interim: the new number is read back in full and confirmed, checked with a one-time code,
  # then the profile is updated. Set TOYOTA_PROFILE_CHANGE_MOBILE_MODE to "transfer" to pass
  # these calls to a person instead.
  # Two ways in: the supervisor's entry for a profile change (change_marked, at the top), and
  # a caller who asks for it in the middle of an identity pass (change_asked). The second also
  # covers a pass that was left waiting and is resumed when the supervisor routes the change
  # here: the request is then done in this activation instead of being handed back again.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  change_asked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      number_change_wanted = false
      entry_profile_update = false
      change_is_entry = false
    THEN: change_mode_gate

  # E120, E121 (demonstration): a demonstration caller's real number is never asked for, texted
  # or stored, so in demonstration mode the change is not made here either.
  change_mode_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      change_task = true
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_PROFILE_CHANGE_MOBILE_MODE}}" == "transfer") OR ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: change_identity_gate
    THEN: fail_change_off

  # E11: only a caller on the number that is on file changes it here; anyone else goes to a person.
  change_identity_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: id_state == "matched" AND profile_id IS SET AND profile_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: change_identify_gate
    THEN: new_mobile_prep

  # E11 (contract v2): "confirm who they are only as far as that needs". A caller nobody has
  # identified yet is identified once, by the calling number alone; a caller identified in any
  # other way (another number, a third party) goes to a person.
  change_identify_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_lookup_done != true AND (id_state == "unknown" OR id_state == "guest")
    ON_FAIL: fail_change_unverified
    THEN: change_identify

  # One profile on the calling number: the change goes ahead (matched_start). Two profiles:
  # the name or a plate is asked first (E08). No profile on it: a person (mobile_ask_prep).
  change_identify:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      change_lookup_done = true
      id_state = "unknown"
      profile_id = COALESCE(crm_customer_id, "")
      profile_name = COALESCE(customer_name, "")
    THEN: lookup_known

  new_mobile_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      newmobile_outcome = "pending"
      newmobile_confirm = "pending"
    CLEAR: [new_mobile]
    THEN: new_mobile_ask

  # E11: takes the new number. A caller who gives the change up, or asks for something else
  # instead, ends the change here; the request is not handed back from the middle of it, so
  # this step is never left waiting for a later, different entry.
  new_mobile_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to change the mobile number on their profile. Ask for the new mobile
      number, in one short question. If they already said it in this call, use it.
      {{#if newmobile_tries}}The number read back before was not right. Apologise in a few words and ask them to say the new number again slowly.{{/if}}
      - A number: store it in new_mobile in international format (a UAE number such as 050 123 4567 becomes +971501234567), then set newmobile_outcome to "given". Do not read it back here; the next step does.
      - They no longer want to change it, or they ask for something else instead: set newmobile_outcome to "cancelled". Do not hand the message back.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Never read out the number that is on the profile now, and say nothing else from the profile."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: newmobile_outcome != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_change_number
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: new_mobile_route

  new_mobile_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: new_mobile_route_given

  new_mobile_route_given:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: newmobile_outcome == "given" AND new_mobile IS SET AND new_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: new_mobile_route_cancel
    THEN: new_mobile_readback_prep

  # Only a clear "no longer" ends the change. An answer that stored no number counts as a
  # failed try and the number is asked for again.
  new_mobile_route_cancel:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: newmobile_outcome == "cancelled"
    ON_FAIL: new_mobile_count
    THEN: change_cancelled

  new_mobile_readback_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      newmobile_confirm = "pending"
    THEN: new_mobile_readback

  # E11 (tool library v2): the tool that changes the number no longer asks the caller to
  # confirm, so the confirmation is here. The number that was stored is read back in full and
  # nothing is sent or changed until the caller says yes to it.
  new_mobile_readback:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Read this new mobile number back to the caller in full, in groups of three or four
      digits, and ask if it is right:
      {{new_mobile}}
      Say only the number. Add nothing else.
      - Yes: set newmobile_confirm to "yes".
      - No, and they give the right number: store the corrected number in new_mobile in international format (a UAE number such as 050 123 4567 becomes +971501234567), then set newmobile_confirm to "corrected".
      - No, without a correction: set newmobile_confirm to "no".
      - They no longer want to change it, or they ask for something else instead: set newmobile_confirm to "cancelled". Do not hand the message back.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [verify_one_time_code]
    STEP_CONSTRAINTS:
      - "Read back only the number written in this step. Never read out the number that is on the profile now, and say nothing else from the profile."
      - "Safety first: on a warning light, leak, smoke, noise, brake or steering problem or fear of driving, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe: store safety_note and carry on. Not safe or unsure: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true. Roadside, accident, injury, child or pet locked in: store safety_note and set safety_raised to true at once."
      - "Asked for a person or upset: store handover_reason (caller_asked, manager_requested when they ask for a manager, or caller_upset) and handover_summary, then set person_requested to true and say nothing more."
      - "Call no tool except to store these values. Store the other values first and the outcome last, because the outcome ends this step. Then say nothing more."
    EXIT_WHEN: newmobile_confirm != "pending" OR safety_raised == true OR person_requested == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: fail_change_number
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: new_mobile_confirm_route

  new_mobile_confirm_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised != true AND person_requested != true
    ON_FAIL: escape_route
    THEN: new_mobile_confirm_yes

  new_mobile_confirm_yes:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: newmobile_confirm == "yes" AND new_mobile IS SET AND new_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: new_mobile_confirm_cancel
    THEN: change_code_setup

  new_mobile_confirm_cancel:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: newmobile_confirm == "cancelled"
    ON_FAIL: new_mobile_count
    THEN: change_cancelled

  # The use case gives no count for this read-back. It follows the plate (E55): after two
  # failed tries nothing is changed and the call goes to a person.
  new_mobile_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      newmobile_tries = ADD(newmobile_tries, 1)
    CHECK: newmobile_tries >= 2
    ON_FAIL: new_mobile_retry_gate
    THEN: fail_change_number

  # A corrected number is read back straight away; otherwise the caller is asked to say it again.
  new_mobile_retry_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: newmobile_confirm == "corrected" AND new_mobile IS SET AND new_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: new_mobile_prep
    THEN: new_mobile_readback_prep

  # E11: checks the new number with a one-time code. The caller knows the number, so its last
  # three digits may be said.
  change_code_setup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      otp_purpose = "change_mobile_number"
      otp_target_spoken = TRIM(REGEX_REPLACE(COALESCE(REGEX_EXTRACT(new_mobile, "[0-9]{3}$"), ""), "([0-9])", "$1 "))
      otp_tries = 0
      otp_send_allowed = true
    CLEAR: [otp_reference, otp_sent, otp_verified, otp_sent_digits]
    THEN: change_code_send

  # E11: texts a code to the new number. The code service is not retried.
  change_code_send:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_one_time_code
      WITH:
        purpose: "change_mobile_number"
        mobile_number: new_mobile
      AS: otp_dispatch
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: otp_dispatch.sent == true
        SET:
          otp_send_allowed = false
        THEN: code_ask_prep
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          otp_send_allowed = false
        THEN: otp_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      SET:
        otp_send_allowed = false
      THEN: fail_system

  # E11: the code passed, so the number on the profile is changed. The caller said yes to the
  # number read back in full before the code was sent (new_mobile_readback); a rule under
  # CONSTRAINTS holds the call back without that yes.
  change_apply:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: update_customer_mobile
      WITH:
        customer_id: profile_id
        new_mobile_number: new_mobile
        code_reference: otp_reference
      AS: mobile_update
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: mobile_update.updated == true
        THEN: change_done
      - ELSE:
        THEN: fail_change_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fail_change_unknown

  change_done:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_mobile = new_mobile
    RESPOND: "That's done. Your profile now has the number ending {{otp_target_spoken}}."
    MESSAGE_KEY: mobile_changed
    THEN: change_exit

  change_cancelled:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "The number on your profile has not been changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: mobile_unchanged
    THEN: change_exit

  # What goes back after the phone-number change. The supervisor's own entry for the change
  # returns the identity it used. A request made in the middle of an identity pass returns
  # identity_status unknown, because that pass did not settle the car: the supervisor then
  # sends the original request through this agent again.
  change_exit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_is_entry == true
    ON_FAIL: change_exit_open
    THEN: change_finish

  change_exit_open:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      id_state = "unknown"
    THEN: change_finish

  # The exit of the phone-number change, whether the number was changed or the caller gave it
  # up (contract v2, section 4). The identity goes back as finish writes it. car_settled goes
  # back false: no car was settled for a request on this exit, also when a car had been
  # confirmed earlier in the same pass, so a booking is never routed on from here without
  # passing the gate again.
  change_finish:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      identity_status = id_state
      crm_customer_id = profile_id
      customer_name = profile_name
      contact_mobile = message_mobile
      identity_outcome = "ok"
      car_settled = false
      handover_reason = ""
      handover_summary = ""
    THEN: COMPLETE

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Leaving without a result (contract v2). This agent never hands off. It sets
  # identity_outcome and completes; the supervisor's first two rules then take the caller to
  # the safety specialist or to a person. Safety wins. Nothing here promises a transfer: the
  # next agent speaks. identity_status goes back as unknown from a pass that did not finish
  # (exit_status), whatever was passed in when a waiting pass was resumed.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  escape_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_raised == true
    ON_FAIL: escape_person_gate
    THEN: escape_safety

  escape_safety:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      safety_note = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(safety_note, "The caller mentioned a possible safety problem with the car.")
      identity_status = exit_status
      identity_outcome = "safety"
    THEN: COMPLETE

  # What is left when it is neither safety nor a person: the caller asked to change the phone
  # number on their profile (E11).
  escape_person_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: person_requested == true
    ON_FAIL: change_asked
    THEN: escape_person

  # The reason and the summary travel to the person through the supervisor. When the caller
  # asked for a person, the speaking step stored both; when a step gave up, its note is the
  # summary. No model call is made here.
  escape_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(handover_reason, "caller_asked"), "caller_asked")
      handover_summary = COALESCE(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(handover_summary, fail_note, "The caller asked for a person while their profile and car were being confirmed. Their request still needs to be handled."), "")
      identity_status = exit_status
      identity_outcome = "person"
    THEN: COMPLETE

  # E26: a system did not answer after the one retry the tool library allows, or the model
  # call itself failed (ON_ERROR comes here): one apology that promises nothing, then a
  # person. No model call and no tool call is made in this step.
  fail_system:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "system_error"
      handover_summary = "A system or the assistant itself failed while the caller's profile or car was being confirmed, or while the mobile number on their profile was being changed. The caller's request has not been handled yet."
      identity_status = exit_status
      identity_outcome = "person"
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now."
    MESSAGE_KEY: system_trouble
    THEN: COMPLETE

  # Each step below gives a reason code and a note for the person, then leaves through
  # escape_person. The caller's answers were not understood after the tries a step allows.
  fail_not_understood:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "not_understood"
      fail_note = "The assistant could not understand the caller's answers while confirming who is calling and which car. Please take over from there."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E120 (demonstration): no sample profile for this caller, and no real details are asked for.
  fail_demo_no_sample:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "demo_no_sample_profile"
      fail_note = "Demonstration call: the systems returned no sample profile for this caller, and an attendee is not asked for a real mobile number or plate, so the caller and the car could not be settled."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E55: two failed read-backs.
  fail_plate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "plate_not_captured"
      fail_note = "The plate number could not be confirmed after two read-backs. Please take the plate and carry on with the caller's request."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  fail_car_not_identified:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "car_not_identified"
      fail_note = "The caller does not know the plate number, so the car could not be identified. Please identify the car and carry on with the caller's request."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E07: the call is about a car of another brand, or the plates given belong to one.
  fail_other_brand:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "other_brand_car"
      fail_note = "The caller's request is about a car of another brand, not a Toyota. This line serves Toyota cars only, so nothing was looked up or booked for that car."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E08: the name or plate did not single out one profile.
  fail_profile_unclear:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "profile_not_resolved"
      fail_note = "More than one customer profile fits this caller, and the name or plate they gave did not single one out. Please confirm the profile and carry on with the caller's request."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E10: the caller cannot get the code.
  fail_tp_code:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "third_party_code_not_confirmed"
      fail_note = "The caller is calling for the car's owner from another number. The one-time code for the registered number could not be sent or confirmed, so no car details were shared. Please confirm they may act for the owner."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # N15: a car that cannot be used and no other car named, or the flag is switched off.
  fail_bad_car:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "car_record_wrong_or_exported"
      fail_note = "The car the caller wants help with is marked wrong or exported on its record, or the caller says the car on file is no longer theirs. Nothing was booked on it. Please check the record and help the caller."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  fail_car_owner:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "car_owner_unclear"
      fail_note = "The car the caller named is linked to a different customer, and how the caller relates to it could not be settled. Please confirm who the car belongs to before helping."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E11: the flag (or demonstration mode) sends phone-number changes to a person.
  fail_change_off:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "mobile_change_by_person"
      fail_note = "The caller wants to change the mobile number on their profile. The assistant does not make this change at the moment."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E11: the caller is not on the number that is on file.
  fail_change_unverified:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "mobile_change_unverified_caller"
      fail_note = "The caller wants to change the mobile number on a profile but is not calling from the number on file, so the assistant did not change it. Please confirm who they are first."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    THEN: escape_person

  # E11: the new number could not be taken or confirmed (two failed read-backs, or answers
  # that were not understood), so nothing was changed. The caller is told so before the call
  # goes to a person.
  fail_change_number:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "mobile_change_number_not_confirmed"
      fail_note = "The caller wanted to change the mobile number on their profile. The new number could not be taken or confirmed, so nothing was sent and nothing was changed."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    RESPOND: "The number on your profile has not been changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: mobile_unchanged
    THEN: escape_person

  # E11: the code for the new number was not confirmed, so nothing was changed.
  fail_change_code:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "mobile_change_code_not_confirmed"
      fail_note = "The caller wanted to change the mobile number on their profile. The one-time code for the new number could not be sent or confirmed, so nothing was changed."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    RESPOND: "The number on your profile has not been changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: mobile_unchanged
    THEN: escape_person

  # E11: the profile system refused the change.
  fail_change_failed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "mobile_change_failed"
      fail_note = "The caller wanted to change the mobile number on their profile. The new number passed the one-time code but the update did not go through, so nothing was changed."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    RESPOND: "The number on your profile has not been changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: mobile_unchanged
    THEN: escape_person

  # E11: the profile system did not answer, so it is not known whether the number changed.
  # The caller is not told either way; a person checks.
  fail_change_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "mobile_change_outcome_unknown"
      fail_note = "The caller wanted to change the mobile number on their profile. The new number passed the one-time code, but the profile system did not answer the update, so it is not known whether the number was changed. Please check the profile."
    CLEAR: [handover_summary]
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now."
    MESSAGE_KEY: system_trouble
    THEN: escape_person
